limitations: Digest equality proves byte identity under the separately trusted pin, not that all prose claims are correct or that the source is trustworthy.
Discovery checks cover this service's documented one skill entry, exact URL, type, digest/version; not a complete generic Agent Skills schema validator.
Strict identity content encoding/no redirects/size limits are conservative auditor policy, not alleged server defects or a universal installer specification.
Live sequential reads are a point-in-time observation and may observe shared caches; no deployment atomicity or future freshness guarantee.
Fixtures are synthetic negative cases, not observed public-service corruption or vulnerabilities. Loopback tests do not validate hostile TLS or proxies.
Byte caps and socket timeout are used; there is no total wall-clock deadline or automated retries. HTTP429 is reported without retry.
PR935's full app constant tests and full Linux/upstream repository gates were not executed; no upstream source change, author adoption, new PR/comment or workflow.
Local/source/live audits use no DID seed or wallet. The protected existing key is used only separately for the explicitly authorized factual DID summary.
No official role, settled testnet compute or airdrop eligibility established.
